name: levels/level-0-agent-id-null
description: Negative fixture: a SELF_ASSERTED AgentCard whose agentId member is JSON null. A Level 0 card may omit agentId, but a member that is present declares an identifier, and null is not a urn:a2a:agent:{domain}:{agent-name}:{version} URN. A conforming verifier MUST reject the declaration shape. A verifier that reads a null member as an absent one accepts the card and fails this fixture.

spec.section: §1 Agent Identity Verification Levels — Agent Identifiers (declared agentId with a null value)

extensions.description: Agent identity verification and trust signals
